METADATA.scope: Nationwide PUBLIC-category holidays generated without a subdivision. Official observed/substitute dates are included. Regional and optional categories are excluded.
METADATA.runtime: Fully offline. python-holidays is used only by the build-time generator; the application reads this non-executable JSON Lines file, one country's line at a time.

rules: Every canonical two-letter country/territory code reported by python-holidays
Labels recurring at least 40 times in one year are removed as weekly rest-day labels
